title.narrative: Response - Recovery - Resilience for Conflict-Affected Communities in Ethiopia Project

description.narrative: To (i) rebuild and improve access to basic services and climate-resilient community infrastructure and (ii) improve access to multi-sectoral response services for Gender-Based Violence (GBV) survivors; in selected conflict-affected communities in Ethiopia.
